subject: Initial MAP template & week-by-week playbook
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@helio.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial MAP template & week-by-week playbook

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, I put together a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a short week-by-week playbook for a 30–45 day evaluation. The goal is to make responsibilities and success criteria explicit so your team can move quickly toward an acceptance milestone.

What I attached/shared:
- MAP_template_v1.gdoc (link below) — MAP skeleton with lanes for stakeholders, success criteria, technical validation steps, and security/compliance checkpoints.
- Week1-playbook-slides.pptx (attached) — 5 slides focused on week 1: sandbox setup, test prompts, basic perf targets, and ownership.

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the two primary stakeholders we should list as owners for product and infra?
2) Are there any hard compliance items (e.g., SOC 2 evidence, IP restrictions) we should add to the security appendix right away?
3) Would Wed Nov 30 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 45-minute workshop to align on the MAP and agree on the acceptance criteria?

Shared draft (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdE-MAP

I’ll leave this open for comments; Marissa & Ben are looped to help populate the technical validation rows and the acceptance tests.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
luke@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: MAP_template_v1.gdoc (stub), Week1-playbook-slides.pptx (stub)

From: Sophie Tran <sophie@helio.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alexg@helio.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP template & week-by-week playbook

Lukas —

Thanks, this looks like a great starting point. Quick notes after a skim:
- Product stakeholder will be me; infra owner is Alex (cc’d).
- We do need a short security appendix — SOC 2 scope and data residency are critical for our procurement team. Can Marissa share the standard SOC2 checklist we usually ask vendors to complete?
- For acceptance criteria, we need:
  * Functional: end-to-end responses for 10 representative prompts, accuracy + fidelity checks (we can send sample prompts).
  * Performance: p95 latency target < 400ms for our sandbox batch size (10 concurrent users).
  * Security: audit log access + 90-day retention for any pilot traces.

We also want to see a short demo of the private deployment options during the workshop if that’s possible.

Wed Nov 30 at 10:00 AM PT should work — please send an invite.

Thanks,
Sophie
Head of Product | Helio Analytics
Sophie.Tran@helio.ai

Sophie / Lukas —

I’ll draft the security appendix and attach the SOC 2 evidence checklist we share with prospects. For the SOC 2 item: we’ll call out required artifacts (system architecture diagram, third-party processing subs, data flow for pilot telemetry) and a point of contact for redlines.

Also adding a technical acceptance row for "latency verification" with a simple test harness plan (we can run a 30-minute p95 measurement inside your sandbox and snapshot results). Ben — can you drop the test harness snippet into the MAP doc (short curl-based runner and expected log output)?

I’ll aim to get the security appendix and the harness snippet into the shared doc by EOD Tues (11/24).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=helio-redwood-map-workshop-20261130

Agenda (45 min):
1) Quick run through MAP lanes & owners (5 min)
2) Security appendix: scope & evidence expectations (10 min)
3) Tech validation plan and harness overview (10 min)
4) Acceptance criteria and demo expectations (10 min)
